cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Manager,

I am excited to apply for the Webshop E-Commerce Administrator position. As a junior digital marketer with a strong technical foundation in web development and SEO, I bring a unique combination of skills that align perfectly with the requirements of this role.

In my current position at Episto, I have honed my e-commerce and digital marketing skills. I manage on-page SEO for client websites, conduct keyword research, and publish keyword-targeted content that drives organic traffic. I also build and maintain WordPress sites using Elementor and the Astra theme, ensuring they are optimized for performance and user experience. My daily use of analytics tools like Google Analytics, Search Console, SEMrush, and Ahrefs allows me to track performance and make data-driven decisions to improve conversions.

My personal project, mirook.com, demonstrates my ability to implement advanced technical SEO and GEO strategies. I designed and built the site from scratch, implemented structured data (JSON-LD schema), and conducted iterative audits to improve its visibility across both traditional and AI-powered search engines. This hands-on experience has given me a deep understanding of how to optimize e-commerce platforms for maximum reach and conversion.

I am particularly drawn to this role because it combines my technical skills with my passion for e-commerce and growth. I am confident that my expertise in platform optimization, data-driven growth, and customer experience will enable me to deliver measurable results for your webshop.

I am eager to bring my strategic thinking and execution capabilities to your team. Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how I can contribute to your success.

Sincerely,

Baver Ok
